_comment: Class order for the on-device sign_lstm.tflite classifier. Must match the label order the model in ai/training/train.py was trained with (see LABELS in ai/dataset/collect_data.py) -- index in this array = model output index. Replace this whole file (e.g. with labels_105.json's contents reshaped to this format) if you swap in the 105-class experimental model; see docs/MOBILE_APP_NOTES.md.
